text.tspan: Plain Java 21, no annotations. Every invariant is enforced here, whoever calls – web, CLI, test or batch.
open(id, clientGroup, party, now) · screen(candidates, policy, now)
resolveMatch(matchId, resolution, rationale, analyst, now) · close(analyst, now)
A closed case cannot be screened, resolved
At most one match per profile; rescreening
updates the score, keeps the resolution.
A POSITIVE may only be downgraded by a
Close only when screened at least once and
no match is UNRESOLVED or POSSIBLE.
Status is derived from the matches; there
Uncle Bob's test for ring 1: would the rule
exist if the bank screened on paper? Yes →
it belongs here. No → it is an application rule.
